python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, re

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
sheet = zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = zin.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

def replace_once(text, old, new, label):
    count = text.count(old)
    assert count == 1, f"{label}: expected 1 occurrence, found {count}"
    return text.replace(old, new)

cvals = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'<c r="([A-Z])(\d+)" t="n"><v>([^<]*)</v></c>', sheet):
    col, r, v = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3))
    cvals.setdefault(r, {})[col] = v

margins = {}
rev_total = profit_total = 0.0
for r in range(2, 10):
    units, price, cost = cvals[r]['C'], cvals[r]['D'], cvals[r]['F']
    rev = units * price
    profit = rev - units * cost
    margins[r] = repr(profit / rev)
    rev_total += rev
    profit_total += profit
margins[10] = repr(profit_total / rev_total)

sheet = replace_once(sheet, 'ref="A1:G10"', 'ref="A1:H10"', 'dimension')
sheet = replace_once(sheet, '</cols>',
                     '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>', 'cols')
sheet = replace_once(sheet,
                     '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
                     '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
                     '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>',
                     'header H1')
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = (f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
           f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v>{margins[r]}</v></c></row>')
    sheet = replace_once(sheet, old, new, f'row {r}')
sheet = replace_once(sheet,
                     '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>',
                     '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
                     f'<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v>{margins[10]}</v></c></row>',
                     'row 10')

styles = replace_once(styles, '<numFmts count="0"/>',
                      '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>',
                      'numFmts')
styles = replace_once(styles, '<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">', 'cellXfs count')
styles = replace_once(styles, '</cellXfs>',
                      '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" '
                      'pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>',
                      'cellXfs entry')

zout = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = sheet.encode('utf-8')
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        data = styles.encode('utf-8')
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()

print('Profit margins computed:', {k: round(float(v), 4) for k, v in margins.items()})
print('File updated successfully.')

margins = {}
rev_total = profit_total = 0.0

    margins[r] = repr(profit / rev)
    rev_total += rev
    profit_total += profit
margins[10] = repr(profit_total / rev_total)
def rep(text, old, new, label):

hdr_new = '<c r=' + Q + 'G1' + Q + ' s=' + Q + '1' + Q + ' t=' + Q + 'inlineStr' + Q + '><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r=' + Q + 'H1' + Q + ' s=' + Q + '1' + Q + ' t=' + Q + 'inlineStr' + Q + '><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>'
sheet = rep(sheet, hdr_old, hdr_new, 'header')

    sheet = rep(sheet, gc + '</row>', gc + hc + '</row>', 'row ' + str(r))

styles = rep(styles, '<numFmts count=' + Q + '0' + Q + '/>', '<numFmts count=' + Q + '1' + Q + '><numFmt numFmtId=' + Q + '164' + Q + ' formatCode=' + Q + '0.0%' + Q + '/></numFmts>', 'numFmts')
styles = rep(styles, '<cellXfs count=' + Q + '3' + Q + '>', '<cellXfs count=' + Q + '4' + Q + '>', 'cellXfs count')
styles = rep(styles, '</cellXfs>', '<xf numFmtId=' + Q + '164' + Q + ' fontId=' + Q + '0' + Q + ' fillId=' + Q + '0' + Q + ' borderId=' + Q + '0' + Q + ' pivotButton=' + Q + '0' + Q + ' quotePrefix=' + Q + '0' + Q + ' xfId=' + Q + '0' + Q + '/></cellXfs>', 'cellXfs entry')

zout.close()
